# CBDB-Desktop -- Group Data Look At Group Data label revisions 2026-10-27

CBDB-Desktop: Group Data (Look At Group Data) label revisions and CBDB-D-002 fix, 2026-10-27

Fifth form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAG). This version of the report is based on the **updated FormLabels (643 rows)** from the user's current CBDB database, which has 30 LAG rows; an earlier version of this report, written before that table was available, took the section names from the Browser's BIO rows instead. The report also records the fix for CBDB-D-002 from the latest automated-testing report. Changes are in the Group Data form's index.html only; no back-end change was needed. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom) with a stand-in server to check the fix and every changed label in all three languages. **Not yet tested in the running app.** A copy of the file before any of these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html.

How to revert a label

All labels are in the T object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. Change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each line has a comment naming its FormLabels row and, where changed, the earlier wording. Where the English changed, the same text is also written in the HTML element (for the tabs, before the count badge); setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load, so editing T.english is enough.

GRP-1: Import, Recall IDs and Clear failed before the first query (CBDB-D-002)

**Symptom.** Before any query had been run, Import from File loaded the IDs correctly but showed "Import error: can't access property "statusRecords", queryData is null", left Clear disabled and left Import from File enabled. Recall IDs worked but showed the same error with "Recall error:". The testing report adds that the page also threw on load, on ticking a query checkbox, and inside Clear, so Clear did not reset the form.

**Cause.** updateRunButton() decides which buttons are enabled. Its first half guarded against there being no result yet (queryData !== null && …), but six lines added later, which enable each GIS dataset checkbox (chkGisStatus … chkGisAddr), read queryData.statusRecords and the other arrays with no guard. queryData is null when the page opens and again after Clear, so every call before the first query threw a TypeError. That is why a query result was being looked at before a query was run: the function that enables Run Query also enables the export controls, and it is called after every import, recall, checkbox change and Clear.

The error stopped updateRunButton() part-way, and then stopped its caller: in the import and recall handlers, the lines that enable Clear and disable Import from File come after the call, so they never ran, and the catch block reported the exception as an import or recall failure. In clearPeople(), everything after the call (re-enabling Import, disabling Clear, clearing the tabs) was skipped. Run Query was set correctly in every case, because it is set before the failing lines, so queries still worked.

On the observation that a second Import click succeeded: in the code as it was, every Import before the first query should have failed in the same way, so I can't account for that difference from the code. The fix removes the failure in either case.

**Fix.** updateRunButton() now reads the result through const d = queryData || {}, counts each dataset's rows once, and sets every control from those counts:

- Store Person IDs, Export Query Results, Save to GIS, Save to Neo4j and the KML checkbox are enabled when any dataset has rows, as before.
- Each GIS dataset checkbox is enabled when its own dataset has rows (Office postings and Office people both follow the Office dataset), as before.
- **New:** a GIS checkbox that becomes disabled is also unticked, and KML is unticked when there are no results. Previously a tick left over from an earlier query stayed in place, invisible behind the grey, and was sent with the next GIS export.

The commented-out older version of the GIS checkbox loop was removed.

**Also changed.** onFileSelected now clears any earlier error message when a file is chosen, as recallStoredIDs already did. Before, an error from an earlier attempt stayed on screen beside the success message of the next one.

**jsdom check** (stand-in server). On load: no error. Recall IDs: no error, Clear enabled, Import from File disabled. Ticking Status: Run Query enabled; GIS Status checkbox still disabled (no results yet). Clear: Import from File enabled, Clear disabled, no error. Import from File with a two-line file: no error, Clear enabled, Import from File disabled.

**Not changed.** Recall IDs stays enabled while a list is loaded, so a recalled list can replace an imported one. Results from a query on the earlier list then stay on screen until the next query, and the export buttons stay enabled for them. See Issues.

Notes

**LBL-39, LBL-48, LBL-49.** Status is now 社會區分, as in BIO 52 and the Browser. This also clears the Group Data item in CBDB-D-004 of the testing report (身份). The table names the same five record types three ways: as query checkboxes (LAG 10–14), as GIS checkboxes (15–20) and as tabs (21–25). The tabs have the longer names (Office Holding, Entry into Government, Text Production 文本與人物角色). For texts, LAG has 文本, where the Browser's tab has 著述 (BIO 46, Writings). Both come from the table, so they were left as they are.

**LBL-40, LBL-41.** LAG 3 is "Search" and LAG 9 "Export to GIS" in English. The Chinese (查詢, 保存于GIS) was adopted. The English "Run Query" and "Save to GIS" were kept, because every other form uses them for the same buttons.

**LBL-42. Store Person IDs.** LAG 4 has 存儲人物代碼 / 存储人物代码. The simplified label follows it. The traditional label uses 儲存 instead of 存儲, because 儲存 is the usual Taiwan term for storing and saving data, while 存储 is the usual mainland computing term. This is the same regional split as 匯出 / 导出. Revert to 存儲人物代碼 if the table's wording is preferred.

**LBL-43.** The panel heading has no LAG row; 人物代碼 is BIO 58 (Person ID).

**LBL-44.** Import People (輸入人名, LAG 1) replaces Import from File; the table uses 輸入 for every Import button. Recall Person IDs (召回人物代碼, LAG 2) follows the table, as on LAAP 22, LAK 28 and LAN 75. An earlier version of this report proposed 調出ID instead, because 召回 also means a product recall. With no preference from the user, the table's wording was kept. CBDB-D-007 in the testing report finds three different translations of Recall IDs across the forms. This term is now the one to use on all of them.

**LBL-45.** As LBL-38 on Entry: the link got id="lnkNavigation", a navigation key, and a line in setLanguage.

**LBL-48.** "Office (Offices)" and "Office (People)" export the postings at the office's address and at the person's index address, which the Chinese makes explicit (官地址 / 人地址). The table's half-width parentheses with a space were kept. The GIS checkbox for addresses was "Place" (地點) and is now "Addresses" (地址), matching its query checkbox.

**LBL-49.** LAG 25's c_jianti has 有関地名, with the Japanese form 関; corrected to 有关地名.

**Comment.** A comment above T points to this report.

Issues

1. **Recall while a list is loaded.** Recall Person IDs can replace a loaded list, but the results of a query on the earlier list stay on screen and their export buttons stay enabled. Either disable Recall while a list is loaded (as Import People is), or clear queryData and the tabs when a new list is recalled.
1. **Store Person IDs stores the loaded list.** storePersonIDs() stores loadedPeople (the input list), not the people in the results. This differs only when some loaded people have no records in the ticked sections. Check that this is intended and say so in the user's guide.
1. **Untranslated text.** The person-list table headers (PersonID, Name, Name (CHN), Index Year, Dynasty, Address), "N people loaded", "Not found:", the results-table headers, "No results yet…", "Querying…", and the status, success and error messages are English only. The header cell thNameChn has an id but is never set.
1. **Results-table headers.** Hard-coded and mixed, as on the other query forms.
1. **Tab width.** The tab bar now has longer English and Chinese names (Entry into Government, 文本與人物角色) plus count badges; check that it does not wrap.

Still to check in the running app

- GRP-1: open the form, Import People (no error; Clear enabled; Import disabled); Clear (form resets); Recall Person IDs (no error); then run a query and check that the GIS dataset checkboxes enable only for sections with results.
- After a query, tick a GIS checkbox, run a query in which that section has no results, and check that the box is unticked and greyed.
- Tab bar and GIS checkbox labels in each language.
